name: [Flood Event] TrenchLine:Tower Defense
desc:
Version 0.24.0 (10/31/26): THE FLOOD UPDATE
Flooded maps: Farmland Lake, Flooded Ruins, Frozen Channel
New event map: Breakwater Port, the coastal town
Boats! Unlock Fleet Command with Naval Tokens (+65 per win on flooded maps)
New enemies: Depth Chargers and flying infected (only some troops can hit them)
2x speed now speeds up the WHOLE game
Buffs: Assault Squad (early levels)
Fixes: Troop Spawner, flying enemies, boat missiles, Rocket Barge

The infection is spreading. Hold the line.

Trench Line is a co-op zombie tower defense game. Build your defenses, upgrade your troops and stop the infected before they break through.

BUILD YOUR LINE
Deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, mortars, tanks, helicopter gunships and now boats.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Fight off shamblers, runners, armored infected, massive Brutes, and now swimmers and flyers.

✅ Easy ✅ Medium ✅ Hard ☠️ENDLESS☠️
Squad up with friends and hold the trench together.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!
Thanks to our dev t

llm.loop: pick map -> deploy troops (riflemen, mortars, tanks, boats) -> stop zombie waves -> earn coins/tokens -> unlock units
llm.objectives: hold the line against infected waves
llm.instructions: build defenses, upgrade troops, stop infected; co-op
unique: military trench zombie TD with naval flood maps
update_signals: THE FLOOD UPDATE v0.24, frequent versioned patches
